name: SK8 Scoop newsletter
label: AVAILABLE NOW
role: Regular local visibility inside the main Friday issue.
best_for: One clear reader action such as visit, book, enquire or try.
commercial_note: Clearly labelled paid placement; editorial remains independent.

name: Timely weekend email
label: PILOT / OPPORTUNISTIC
role: A lighter, time-sensitive email when the audience and timing genuinely justify an extra send.
best_for: Events, short-lived offers and things readers can act on immediately.
commercial_note: Not guaranteed inventory; availability depends on editorial timing and audience fit.

name: SK8 Scoop guides
label: CONTEXTUAL FIT
role: Longer-life visibility inside useful guides when the business genuinely belongs in that reader context.
best_for: Offers, attractions and services with durable relevance rather than a one-day promotion.
commercial_note: Guide inclusion is not automatic; relevance and clear labelling come first.

name: NUE website
label: BEING PREPARED
role: Searchable local discovery surfaces that can eventually connect useful commercial messages to relevant pages and categories.
best_for: Persistent local discovery once website advertising passes readiness and measurement checks.
commercial_note: Not standard paid inventory yet. No website placement should be sold as guaranteed until the readiness gate is passed.
